summary: Fresh reconciliation proves the timestamp-only Worker Wave writer named by this recovery capsule has been retired from the current architecture. main no longer contains .github/workflows/prometeo-control-plane-live-v1.yml, gh-pages no longer contains live/worker-wave.json, and the current live-feed publisher does not write worker-wave.json or live/batches/*.json. The historical noisy commit remains valid evidence of the old bug, but there is no current exact owner/surface to patch. Recreating or relocating the retired writer would widen scope and reintroduce the churn surface. The stale recovery is therefore closed without implementation mutation.
